## Statement

Let $G$ be a finite [[group|1A2B3C]] and $H$ a [[subgroup|1H8D2C]] of $G$.
Then $|H|$ divides $|G|$.

## Remarks

The converse fails: $A_4$ has order 12 and no subgroup of order 6 ([[counterexample|5ZQ1PM]]).
